Mthly Mash Pump P-101 Mech Inspect
Wkly Brewhouse Panel & Sensor Electrical Inspect

pmOperations.tasks:
Inspect The Mechanical Seal For Any Product Or Caustic Leakage
Check The Seal Flush Line Is Flowing And Lines Are Not Blocked
Wipe The Seal Area Dry And Mark Today's Inspection Date With Chalk

Check Motor Running Current On The Panel And Compare With Nameplate FLA
Check For Abnormal Noise, Heat Or Vibration On The Pump Set
Record Discharge Pressure And Tank Conductivity In The Daily Log

Check The Pump Body For Accumulation Of Solids
Clean The Sump And Strainer Housing, Report Any Abnormal Debris

Check The Condition Of The Proximity Sensor And Clean Accumulated Dust On The Sensor
Check The Condition Of Metallic Plate Infront Of The Sensor

Clean Body Of The Main Drives & Machine Area
Colour Indicates Residue And Severe Thermal Decomposition Replace Oil If Any Of These Were Observed
Check The Gear Box Oil Levels And The Quality Of The Oil, Cloudy And Floucculent Appearance Indicates Water Contamination
Check Main Drive Foundation Bolts For Tightness
Check Motor Cable Gland To Terminal Box
Inspect Cable Terminals For Burns
Document All Findings & Report Asap Any Abnormality

Check The Functionality Of Level Transmitter On The HMI And The Level Switch
Check For Any Caustic Leakage On The Transmitters, If Any Call For Repair
Inspect The Valve For Any Caustic Leakages, If Any Call For Repair
Inspect The Pump For Any Caustic Leakages And Abnormal Noise, If Any Call For Repair
Check The Functionality Of Level Transmitter On The SCADA

Check This Pilot Air Hose Supply To The Valves, If Properly Connected
Check For Air Leakages And Rectify
Inspect The Valve For Any Caustic Leakages, If Any Call For Repair

Check Terminal Tightness On The Temperature Transmitter Panel
Look For Discoloration Or Burns On Cable Terminals
Confirm Cable Glands Are Sealed Against Steam Ingress

Test Panel Indicator Lamps And HMI Alarms
Measure And Record Panel Supply Voltage
Verify Earth Bonding Is Intact

Inspect Pump Seal For Glycol Weeping, If Any Call For Repair
Check Suction And Discharge Pressures And Record Values

Confirm The Valve Cycles Correctly On The HMI Signal Test
Inspect Coil Housing For Moisture Ingress

Change Air Filter Element And Oil Separator
Sample And Replace Compressor Oil, Check For Thermal Decomposition
Check Belt Tension And Coupling Alignment

Megger Test Motor Windings And Record Values
Inspect Cable Terminals For Burns
Verify Overload Relay Settings Against Nameplate FLA

Calibrate Pressure Switch And Record Set Points
Test Safety Relief Valve, If Faulty Replace Immediately

Inspect pump gland for feedwater weeping
Check suction strainer differential
Record discharge pressure and flow
